problems.label: ass:15053-rec10-q2
notes: Original timing is ambiguous. If a prior optimal do-not-play choice is irrevocable, later information has value 0. If play has already been externally committed, information gives net payoff 0.2 versus uninformed payoff -0.4, so its conditional incremental value is 0.6. A third legitimate protocol announces information availability before the play commitment but reveals the answer afterward: optimal expected payoff before the information fee is 0.2, versus 0 without information, so the maximum information fee is 0.2; the official figure is valid under this protocol. If information is revealed before the play decision, its value is 0.4. The solution explicitly separates these timing protocols.
